title: Supported constant normalization for cyclic coefficient continuation
statement: Let l,Y,E,pi,n,A,hA and q be as in UniformizerSquareData [def-diagonal-uniformizer-root-frame]. Put rho=restriction(q), TC=cyclicFunctor(q), TA=quotientFunctor(q), S the single supported Z_l unit, and sR=cyclicSource, sA=quotientSource [def-diagonal-coefficient-route-endpoints]. There is a unique ordinary right-functor isomorphism s:quotientRight(q) -> rho followed by cyclicRight(q) for which U(s_M)=uA(M) followed by inverse uR(rho M), where uA and uR are inverseUnderlying. Its constructed derived mate tau=comparison(s) satisfies tau_S followed by D(rho)(sA.hom) followed by the exact single comparison of rho = sR.hom followed by single(i_* maps.source). These are precisely RestrictionNormalized(q,s) and SourceEquation(q,s) [def-diagonal-coefficient-route-comparison]. No initial diagonal arrow or root endpoint is involved.

source.place: paragraph (1), finite cyclic reduction followed by finite coefficient extension

proof.text: Transport the identity underlying abelian sheaf through inverseUnderlying for the two inverse finite realizations. The Z_l actions agree because the actual quotient coefficient map factors through the cyclic quotient by hA; on cyclic constant generators the factor is the unital cartierResidueAlgebra map. This produces a natural module isomorphism. Faithful forgetting proves uniqueness.

Take the actual derived mate of that restriction isomorphism. Transpose the supported endpoint through scalar adjunctions. Endpoint.normalization reduces it to supportMap of the regular unit. The finite unit and source normalizations identify this with maps.source on constant generators, hence on the sheafification. Exact single comparisons give SourceEquation.
